slug: 2026-02-20 Malawi validates AI strategy, digital transformation policy - CAJ News Africa

facts.fact: CAJ News reports that Malawi 'has begun the validation' of the 'Draft National Digital Transformation Strategy', described as a 'prospective blueprint', at a two-day workshop in Lilongwe opened by the Principal Secretary for E-Government on the Wednesday before 20 February 2026 (18 February); the exercise is to validate the draft 'before finalisation', and no adoption is stated.

On 18 February 2026 the Ministry of ICT, through the Department of E-Government and with UNDP, began validating the draft National Digital Transformation Strategy and launched the 'Shape Malawi's Digital and AI Future Portal' to collect public feedback before finalisation.
